role: independent research contributor; no native training or promotion
objective: Qualify a genuine converged rank4 conventional refit comparator before a NEW primary experiment. WSP-210 primary is INVALID from the fixed 100-sweep cap; its partially exposed cohort is never rerun.

datasets.split: Existing WSP200 salted whole pair groups and FIT B0-B3; PUBLIC_DEV only once after all stage fits; VALID and RESERVED labels never generated.
datasets.generator: Reuse independent fabricated WSP210 rank4 factor dot product with different world identifiers; no original GFP data.

methods.full_refit_100: Original frozen 100-sweep control is historical WSP-210 INVALID; do not run on its cohort.
methods.batched_refit: On isolated WSP211, run 8 ordinary WSP200 full-coordinate sweeps per outer objective check, at most 100 outer checks = 800 actual sweeps per stage; require three consecutive nonnegative relative reductions <= 1e-6, preserve the original loss and factor initialization.
methods.adam: Independent existing WSP210 full batch rank4 Adam, 2500-epoch stage cap, 300 minimum, 100-epoch relative objective plateau <=1e-6; identical staged evidence and regularization.
methods.zero_readout: Standardized zero interaction prediction, non-fitted negative control.

metrics: Per-stage actual coordinate sweeps, loss, convergence, B0 normalized MSE, cold byte restoration parity, held group RMSE only after B3, source/cost/seed receipts, no target data leak.

decision.control_qualified: Both disjoint dev worlds have all 4 stages, refit convergence and Adam plateau, finite objectives, cold restoration, no repeated sample IDs, no label crossover; otherwise CONTROL_UNQUALIFIED.
decision.learning_diagnostic: Report any training/held gain compared with zero-readout but do not treat source-free calibration as scientific improvement.
decision.next_on_pass: Freeze a new fully disjoint primary cohort and thresholds BEFORE first evaluation in a separate subsequent contribution. No automatic source first-use.
decision.next_on_fail: Preserve failure; do not adapt on either development seed, propose another independently frozen calibration before any primary.

platform: Python 3.12 standard library, GitHub-hosted Windows2022 and ubuntu-24.04, exact pinned source full regression + G29, no new controllers, paid APIs, self-hosted runner or unattended work
